Canticles of the Omnissiah: At the start of the Command phase, choose a single Canticle of the Omnissiah. All units with this rule that are partially within 9" of a model with "Choir Master" roll a D6; on a 4+, they gain the benefits of the chosen Canticle until the end of the Battle Round.
Choir Master: Units containing this model automatically pass their Canticle of the Omnissiah roll.
Cognis: The weapon reduces its total penalty to hit rolls in ranged combat by -1, down to a minimum of 0.

Luminagen: A unit that suffers one or more unsaved Wounds, glancing or penetrating hits caused by a weapon with this special rule counts its cover saves as being 1 point worse than normal until the end of the battle round. Furthermore, they suffer an additional -1 to hit penalty for Defensive fire.
Monotask: This unit does not benefit from Canticles of the Omnissiah unless it is accompanied by a character with "Choir Master".
Tesla: To hit rolls of 5+ are always successful and the target suffers 2 additional automatic hits.
